strengths.quote: And the right business will *always* stand up and perform for you"—here Freya smiled—"which, let's face it, gives it a distinct advantage over a man.
the feed suddenly bloomed with rainbow-haired avatars like an exotic greenhouse
No matter what they smelled like.
had traded their soup ladles for oversized smartphones
